definitions.name: U1C.PICK-MAX-KEY
definitions.body: 'R' BIND R KEYS 'K' BIND R VALUES -1 MUL ORDER 0 GET 'I' BIND K I GET
definitions.note: Record of counts -> its key with the largest value, the earliest key on a tie.
